## Activity

During October 2024, River Outreach recorded 77 captures. This is the reported activity total for the month. The result provides a straightforward basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. Any operational review should consider the activity figure alongside the proportion of captures that could not be assessed and the number of results identified as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 77 captures, 10 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 13.0 per cent of captures. The recurring camera issues identified by the clinic lead should be logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the usual support process. Consistent recording of these issues will also assist with monitoring image quality in subsequent reporting periods.

## Grading

A total of 15 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. Together, these figures describe the grading activity associated with the month’s captures and indicate that referable findings formed part of the reported workload. The activity, image-quality, and grading measures should be reviewed together when considering site operations and any required follow-up.
